resources.string: Your foldable, now with the authentic 2026 hinge experience. Shows up only when the phone is unfolded.

Parody / prank app. Nothing is actually broken: it only draws fake dead/stuck pixels on top of the inner screen while unfolded, and touches pass straight through. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Apple. No ads, no internet, no data collected.
Tap Stop to magically repair it.
